note: RATCHET. mtime_only_files may SHRINK and may never grow. mtime cannot detect an artifact written after an input it read before, which is how a 7,100-game WOBBUFFET re-run was cleared as ok on 2026-08-04 while measuring two different defenders. The LIST is recorded rather than a count: the first time this fired it could only say "one more than last time", nobody could tell which file, and status.js printed NOT DERIVED for a session. THE ONE WAY IT MAY GROW is a recorded DISCOVERY — the checker learning to see artifacts it could not see before is the opposite event from a generator dropping its stamp, and every such growth is listed in `discoveries` with its date, its reason and its files.
